description: Use when an agent needs recent material disclosures of a South Korean listed company (rights offerings, CBs, buybacks, M&A, litigation, earnings, periodic reports). Input: corp (DART corp_code, KRX stock code or kr-dart- id) or q (exact name), optional days (1-365, default 30); or date (YYYY-MM-DD, KST). Output: JSON list with rceptNo, date, Korean title, English type label, DART link. Summaries: /v1/kr/filings/summary. Example: ?corp=005930&days=90 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

corp.description: DART corp_code (8 digits), KRX stock code (6 characters) or kr-dart-<corp_code>

date.description: Receipt date (KST); with corp, only that day

q.description: Company name (Korean or English), matched exactly after removing legal-form words

name: kr_filings
title: Korean DART filings: recent major disclosures for a company or a day, with English type labels
